2607.05377.title: Cortex: A Bidirectionally Aligned Embodied Agent Framework for Long-horizon Manipulation
2607.05377.paper_summary: While recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models show promise toward generalist manipulation policies, they struggle with long-horizon tasks due to their Markovian nature-relying solely on current observations. Hierarchical dual-system methods address this but suffer from a gap between high-level planning semantics and low-level execution kinematics. We introduce Cortex, a bidirectionally aligned embodied agent framework with a customized planning interface that conveys executable and tractable subtask plans from high-level VLM to low-level VLA. Specifically, we standardize manipulation subtasks into 32 canonical skill primitives and inject tractability principles, such as representative object attributes and improved trajectory reachability, into the data generation pipeline. This enables automatic annotation of over 4k hours of open-source video data and generation of 30 hours of simulation data. We further devise an event-balanced sampling strategy to construct training data for fine-tuning the framework to better handle planning ambiguity during subtask transitions, enhanced by carefully designed harness engineering from task contexts to skill constraints during inference. Both open-loop VLM and closed-loop system evaluations demonstrate Cortex's efficacy, e.g., it outperforms monolithic baselines by 3.1% on Libero-long and 4.1% on RoboTwin. Notably, Cortex's generalist VLM enables zero-shot completion of unseen real-world long-horizon tasks, such as multi-stage chemistry experiments, by simply combining with a fine-tuned VLA-a capability infeasible through VLA fine-tuning alone.
2607.05377.paper_summary_zh: 雖然最近的視覺-語言-行動（VLA）模型在通用操控策略方面顯示出潛力，但由於其馬可夫性質，僅依賴當前觀察，因而在長期任務上表現不佳。分層雙系統方法解決了這一問題，但在高層次規劃語義與低層次執行運動學之間存在差距。我們介紹了Cortex，一個雙向對齊的具身代理框架，具有自定義的規劃接口，能夠將可執行且可處理的子任務計劃從高層次VLM傳達到低層次VLA。具體而言，我們將操控子任務標準化為32個典範技能原語，並將可處理性原則（如代表性物體屬性和改進的軌跡可達性）注入數據生成管道中。這使得自動標註超過4000小時的開源視頻數據和生成30小時的模擬數據成為可能。我們進一步設計了一種事件平衡的抽樣策略，以構建訓練數據，對框架進行微調，以更好地處理子任務轉換期間的規劃模糊性，並通過精心設計的任務上下文到技能約束的工程來增強推理過程。開環VLM和閉環系統評估均展示了Cortex的有效性，例如，在Libero-long上超越單體基準3.1%，在RoboTwin上超越4.1%。值得注意的是，Cortex的通用VLM使得對未見的現實世界長期任務（如多階段化學實驗）的零-shot完成成為可能，只需與微調過的VLA結合——這是僅通過VLA微調無法實現的能力。
